label: a2-commitment: D1 after a rewarded rare a2->S1 trial, and GO when choosing a2 after no reward
explanation: Fires only on D1 and GO steps, never at D2. It fires almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 or has just chosen it (97% of activation mass falls on a2 trials; it fires on none of the GO steps where the model picks a1), and it tracks a strongly negative policy logit. There are two observed contexts. (1) D1 right after an a2 trial that went rare to S1 and was rewarded: precision 0.76, about 35% of mass. These are the strongest activations (top quartile), i.e. the reward is revealed for a rare outcome that the agent will not use to switch away from a2. (2) GO when the model selects a2 and the previous trial was unrewarded and was not an a1 trial (a2 or unknown at the start of the window): about 60% of mass, mid-range magnitudes, somewhat larger after rare a2 transitions (precision 0.71 vs 0.52 after common ones). Dev split: P 0.64, R 0.95, mass recall 0.95. Adding choice < -3 raises P only to 0.67. The FUTURE action == 2 scores the same as the model own argmax model_act == 2 at GO, so I recorded the version with no future variables. Precision is incomplete: many GO steps where the agent stays on a2 after a loss are inactive, so this is partially explained, not fully.
